name: Hone Orthopedics
description: Hone Orthopedics: a block theme for an orthopedic and sports injury clinic. A cool off-white ground with a slate primary, tall rounded portraits bleeding off both edges of the first screen, a thick round-capped ribbon over a pale disc and dark arc, and 3:4 photo cards with a notched arrow tab. A joint finder, specialist directory, hours dot grid and fee card. Source Serif 4 and Source Sans 3. Sample content in English; inner pages and other languages follow. Works without any plugin. WCAG AA colours; no entrance animations.
